name: 128bittracker-mobile
description: 128bit Tracker for Android (Capacitor). Runs the same Tracker core on-device with SQLite (sql.js).

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
